description: This file contains a shell script designed to read back transmission power (txpower) information for wireless interfaces using the 'iw' command. It includes comments explaining the purpose, notes about behavior, and code to iterate over wireless interfaces, extract txpower info, and normalize output.

methods.name: Main script logic
methods.description: Checks for presence of 'iw', verifies wireless interfaces, and outputs txpower information per interface, replacing actual values with placeholders.
